Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1898 (5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 1B). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1898, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
